papers.title: EpiCoder: Encompassing Diversity and Complexity in Code Generation
papers.target: EpiCoder's function-level synthetic data (380k samples) attains Halstead complexity of 10.66 unique operators, 44.32 unique operands, 56.98 total operators and 100.36 total operands, roughly doubling the strongest baseline (OSS-Instruct: 7.44 / 20.99 / 28.05 / 47.55; Code Alpaca: 4.83 / 8.22 / 10.66 / 15.89), i.e. the core claim that feature-tree synthesis yields far more complex code data.
blockers: The headline results (Table 1 Pass@1, Figure 4 XFileDep) require supervised fine-tuning of 6.7B-7B models on 380k+53k samples - multiple GPU-days, not laptop-feasible
Table 2's exact sample set, deduplication and parser configuration are not specified, so reproduced averages will drift from the reported values

The paper states 'code and data are publicly available' but no direct URL for the 380k function-level dataset appears in the provided links; hosting (GitHub vs. HuggingFace) must be verified before download
Tables 3/4/15 (diversity, LLM-judge complexity) depend on GPT-4o API calls and cannot be reproduced without a paid closed model

papers.target: Shadow-FT (LoRA, r=128) tuned on BAAI-2k raises the Math-7 average of Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct to 27.2, versus 25.3 for conventional LoRA FT and 23.8 for the vanilla INSTRUCT baseline.
papers.table_ref: Table 1 (row: Llama-3.2-1B; column: Avg./Math-7 under Full & LoRA)
blockers: The published protocol uses 8xA100 GPUs and reports means over 3 independent training runs; a single laptop run is a weakened reproduction.
Evaluation is done via OpenCompass + lmdeploy, and lmdeploy is CUDA-serving oriented, so a CPU evaluator would have to be rebuilt around transformers/vLLM-CPU.
Gated model licenses (Meta Llama 3.2/3.1) require HF account approval even though weights are free.
The BAAI-2k subset selection (high-reward filtering + uniform category sampling) must be re-derived from Infinity-Instruct/Gen, which may not exactly match the paper's 2k.
No paired BASE model exists for some LLMs (acknowledged in Limitations), though it does exist for the chosen Llama-3.2-1B target.
